ModMetaData.name: RimMT V0.9.3 Consolidated Stable
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.9.3 Consolidated Stable for RimWorld 1.5. Rollback build using the last consolidated stable production source before the V0.9.4-V0.9.12 continuation and predictive-admission experiments. Keeps the validated JobGiver, DoBill, ReachProfile, haul and topology production paths; resident hot-path profilers, PathSnapshot shadow validation, SafePath telemetry and WorkPrefilter are excluded. Final gameplay decisions remain Vanilla-authoritative and acceleration paths fail closed.
